name: Point Topic
description:
Free, no-signup access to Point Topic's UK broadband reference data. Query
the entity graph of the industry: ISPs, network operators, networks, links
and link standards, ownership and wholesale relationships, retail/wholesale
flags, and consolidation history — all with SQL.

Example questions you can answer:
- Who owns which networks, and which ISPs ride them (e.g. who uses
  CityFibre or Openreach)?
- What does the UK market structure look like — retail vs wholesale vs
  business-only operators?
- Which link standards (FTTP, XGS-PON, DOCSIS…) are in use and by whom?
- What consolidations have reshaped the market?

The endpoint exposes only the public reference tables. Licensed measurement
data — network footprints, premises counts, speeds, tariffs, coverage
forecasts, take-up and subscriber statistics — is not queryable here and
requires a Point Topic licence; denied queries return a clear message with
contact details.

Data is global in scope; filter COUNTRY = 'United Kingdom' for UK-specific
queries. Current rows: VALID_TO IS NULL. Columns are UPPERCASE; run
SHOW TABLES FROM ontology to explore.

Built and maintained by Point Topic Ltd — broadband market research since
1998. Contact: info@point-topic.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Point Topic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Point Topic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.point-topic.com/public.

_published_faq.name: Is Point Topic MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Point Topic scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Point Topic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Point Topic provides these MCP tools: database_tools_execute_query.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Point Topic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Point Topic in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Pricing Optimizer AI, StatCite, and ClickHouse Cloud MCP Server.

_published_faq.name: Does Point Topic MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Point Topic does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Point Topic is developed by Point Topic Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
